newsitem.title: USA: PairGain comfortable with EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: PairGain comfortable with EPS estimates.

text.p: Howard Flagg, president of PairGain Technologies Inc said Wednesday he was comfortable with analyst's earnings estimates for the fourth quarter and for fiscal 1997.

"We feel comfortable with the consensus but we don't want to get anyone wound-up excessively," Flagg said in an interview. "We feel very comfortable but in terms of beating it ... we're not going to beat it by a lot."

According to First Call analysts had predicted the company would earn $0.24 in the fourth quarter and $1.15 for fiscal 1997. Flagg said those numbers did not include revised estimates from some analysts on Wednesday which will boost the estimates to $0.26 a share and $1.25 respectively.

"If you look at our performance over the last few quarters we haven't had any major surprises, the variance in what was expected and what PairGame achieved was never beyond anyones imagination," he said.
Shares of PairGain fell 7 to 73-3/4 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq but Flagg was not overly concerned.
"Considering our growth rate and considering we're already into next year I don't think it's a particularly lofty share price," he said. "It's where I have my money."
